statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation contributing to stroke risk
The service is to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73, I49.5, and I49.9
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
Prairie State Medicaid determined that another plan holds primary responsibility for this benefit
